posts.text: Tail is correct, not a gaffe. An auction 'tails' when the Treasury has to pay a higher yield (interest rate) to sell its bonds than the market expected right before the auction. It's a sign of weak demand, not a failed auction: www.dallasfed.org/research/eco...
